@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.executor.task_queue_manager import DisplaySend, FinalQueue
+from ansible.plugins.strategy import StrategySentinel, results_thread_main
+from ansible.utils.display import Display
+
+
+def test_final_queue_preserves_display_method_and_arguments():
+    queue = FinalQueue()
+    try:
+        queue.send_display('warning', 'message', formatted=True)
+        result = queue.get()
+        assert isinstance(result, DisplaySend)
+        assert result.method == 'warning'
+        assert result.args == ('message',)
+        assert result.kwargs == {'formatted': True}
+    finally:
+        queue.close()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('method', ['warning', 'deprecated'])
+def test_results_thread_deduplicates_worker_messages(monkeypatch, capsys, method):
+    display = Display()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(display, '_final_q', None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(display, '_warns', {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(display, '_deprecations', {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.utils.display.logger', None)
+
+    strategy = MagicMock()
+    strategy._final_q.get.side_effect = [
+        DisplaySend(method, 'repeated message'),
+        DisplaySend(method, 'repeated message'),
+        StrategySentinel(),
+    ]
+
+    results_thread_main(strategy)
+
+    assert capsys.readouterr().err.count('repeated message') == 1

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('method', ['display', 'warning', 'deprecated'])
